description: Convert a CSV into a JSON array of objects keyed by the header, with documented type coercion: empty becomes null, integers and numbers become numbers, true and false become booleans, everything else stays a string. Choose this when you need a CSV delivered as JSON records, with documented type coercion: empty to null, numbers to numbers, true and false to booleans. Do not choose this when you need a module that performs the conversion inside your own pipeline (use csv-json-transformation), or when the target shape is nested: CSV is flat. Example requests: Turn this CSV into a JSON array of objects. | Convert this spreadsheet export to JSON for my API. | Give me this CSV as JSON records, with numbers as numbers.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

content.description: The customer's input.csv, as text. Supported: CSV, TSV or any delimiter-separated text (comma, semicolon, tab, pipe). Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_csv_to_json_rows
title: CSV to JSON records
